description: New Zealand Estimated Resident Population Grid 500 metre is a dataset listed in Stats NZ Geographic Data Service (datafinder.stats.govt.nz), New Zealand, an open data portal, published or maintained by GIS. A 500 metre population grid using the population estimates published annually, dated as at 30 June. The population estimates are based on the most recent census-based Estimated Resident Population (ERP), and updated for population change. Population estimates by Statistical Area 1s (SA1s) are used as an input to derive population grids. Coverage: New Zealand. The portal files it under the publisher GIS. Its tags are 500 metre grid, 500m, Downloadable Data, grids. It offers 1 resource(s) in vector. The portal shows 2026-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the portal's own catalogue entry (title, description, tags, licence, formats and dates) read through its API, so the data files were not opened, their contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-nz-stats-portal.
